Exam Bootcamp

Five days. Every exam topic. Past papers marked like the real thing.

A five-day online bootcamp in the school holidays before the exams. Three hours a day across every exam topic, with past-paper questions marked the way the real exam is marked. Open to Grade 12 and Second Chances learners. There are two runs in 2027.

Who it is for: Grade 12 and Second Chances learners getting ready for their exams.

01 · What your child gets

Small groups, a fixed plan, feedback on every homework.

  • Five live days of three hours each, across every exam topic
  • Past-paper questions cited by year and paper, marked like the real exam
  • Paper 1 and Paper 2 revision, each topic taught under the correct paper
  • A homework pack for each day
Every session follows the same four parts
  1. Key concepts checklist. What your child needs to know, on one page.
  2. Worked anchor question. A past-paper question, solved step by step.
  3. Guided live practice. Your child works while the tutor watches and steps in.
  4. Homework pack. Submitted on WhatsApp, with voice-note feedback within 48 hours.

Questions parents ask

About Exam Bootcamp

Who can join?

Grade 12 learners and Second Chances learners. It is built for the weeks before the exam, so it works best for learners who have already covered the syllabus.

What does early bird mean?

The early-bird price is R500 and the standard price is R800. Message us on WhatsApp if you're unsure which price applies when you enrol.

Can I get a refund?

Yes, up to 7 days before the bootcamp starts.

Does it replace weekly classes?

No. It is an exam-preparation sprint that adds to the weekly classes, not a substitute.

More questions? See the full FAQ or ask us on WhatsApp.
